\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{آلودگی} (âludegi)}{آلودگی (âludegi)}]{\fa{آلودگی} (âludegi) — pollution}

\label{lesson:FA-C388-aludegi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a majority, then the Persian for discrimination.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{آلودگی}}
\textbf{\fa{آلودگی}} (\emph{âludegi}) — \textquotedblleft{}pollution\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{آلودگی} \fa{هوا} \fa{در} \fa{شهرهای} \fa{بزرگ} \fa{زیاد} \fa{است}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{âludegi-ye havâ dar shahrhâ-ye bozorg ziyâd ast.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Air pollution is high in big cities.
\end{quote}

From \emph{âlude} \textquotedblleft{}dirty, polluted\textquotedblright{}, the participle of \emph{âludan} \textquotedblleft{}to stain\textquotedblright{}, + \emph{-gi}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{آلودگی}} is native Persian, built on \emph{âlude} \textquotedblleft{}stained, polluted\textquotedblright{}, the participle of \emph{âludan} \textquotedblleft{}to stain\textquotedblright{}, with the noun suffix \emph{-gi}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{âludegi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{âludegi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{âludegi}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a majority, then the Persian for discrimination, then say \emph{âludegi} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{بازیافت} (bâzyâft)}{بازیافت (bâzyâft)}]{\fa{بازیافت} (bâzyâft) — recycling}

\label{lesson:FA-C388-bazyaft}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for discrimination, then the Persian for pollution.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{بازیافت}}
\textbf{\fa{بازیافت}} (\emph{bâzyâft}) — \textquotedblleft{}recycling\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{بازیافت} \fa{کاغذ} \fa{درختها} \fa{را} \fa{نجات} \fa{میدهد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{bâzyâft-e kâghaz derakhthâ râ nejât midahad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Recycling paper saves trees.
\end{quote}

\emph{Bâz} \textquotedblleft{}again, back\textquotedblright{} + \emph{yâft} \textquotedblleft{}found\textquotedblright{}, from \emph{yâftan} \textquotedblleft{}to find\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{بازیافت}} is a modern native coinage built from \emph{bâz} \textquotedblleft{}back, again\textquotedblright{} + \emph{yâft}, the past stem of \emph{yâftan} \textquotedblleft{}to find\textquotedblright{}. Recycling finds a material again.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bâzyâft}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bâzyâft}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{bâzyâft}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for discrimination, then the Persian for pollution, then say \emph{bâzyâft} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{بازیافت} \fa{کردن} (bâzyâft kardan)}{بازیافت کردن (bâzyâft kardan)}]{\fa{بازیافت} \fa{کردن} (bâzyâft kardan) — to recycle}

\label{lesson:FA-C388-bazyaft-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for pollution, then the Persian for recycling.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{بازیافت} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{بازیافت} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{bâzyâft kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to recycle\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{ما} \fa{بطریهای} \fa{پلاستیکی} \fa{را} \fa{بازیافت} \fa{میکنیم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{mâ bottrihâ-ye plâstiki râ bâzyâft mikonim.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
We recycle plastic bottles.
\end{quote}

\emph{Bâzyâft} + \emph{kardan} (stem \emph{kon-}). The object takes \emph{râ}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{بازیافت} \fa{کردن}} is native Persian, built from \emph{bâzyâft} \textquotedblleft{}recycling\textquotedblright{}, from \emph{bâz} \textquotedblleft{}again\textquotedblright{} and \emph{yâft} \textquotedblleft{}found\textquotedblright{}, with \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{مصرف} (masraf)}{مصرف (masraf)}]{\fa{مصرف} (masraf) — consumption, use}

\label{lesson:FA-C388-masraf}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for recycling, then the Persian for to recycle.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{مصرف}}
\textbf{\fa{مصرف}} (\emph{masraf}) — \textquotedblleft{}consumption, use\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{مصرف} \fa{برق} \fa{در} \fa{تابستان} \fa{بالا} \fa{میرود}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{masraf-e barq dar tâbestân bâlâ miravad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Electricity use goes up in summer.
\end{quote}

Also the dosage of a medicine: \emph{tarz-e masraf}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{مصرف}} was borrowed from Arabic \emph{maṣraf} (EtymDB), a word usually glossed as a place or way of spending; in Persian it is consumption.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{masraf}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{masraf}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for recycling, then the Persian for to recycle, then say \emph{masraf} again
\end{itemize}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{مصرف} \fa{کردن} (masraf kardan)}{مصرف کردن (masraf kardan)}]{\fa{مصرف} \fa{کردن} (masraf kardan) — to consume, to use up}

\label{lesson:FA-C388-masraf-kardan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to recycle, then the Persian for consumption.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{مصرف} \fa{کردن}}
\textbf{\fa{مصرف} \fa{کردن}} (\emph{masraf kardan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to consume, to use up\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{این} \fa{ماشین} \fa{بنزین} \fa{زیادی} \fa{مصرف} \fa{میکند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{in mâshin benzin-e ziyâdi masraf mikonad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
This car uses a lot of petrol.
\end{quote}

\emph{Masraf} + \emph{kardan}. For food, fuel, medicine and electricity.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{مصرف} \fa{کردن}} joins \emph{masraf}, from Arabic \emph{maṣraf} (EtymDB), to the inherited Persian verb \emph{kardan} \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}
